Question 3
?

Construct the vector field that has the stream function ψ(x,y)=excos⁡y−x.

a
F(x,y)=excos⁡yi−eycos⁡xj
b
F(x,y)=excos⁡yi+(exsin⁡y−1)j
c
F(x,y)=−exsin⁡yi+(−excos⁡y+1)j
d
